name: Beethoven
source:
"...A symphony... I'm worried..."

Based on Ludwig van Beethoven.

A tight-lipped character who goes at her own pace. Beethoven usually holes up in her home in Vienne composing music, and almost never shows up to meetings or events. Lately, she seems to be in a something of a slump.

She's the type to live according to her inspirations, and loses sight of her surroundings whenever she's concentrating. She is somewhat single-minded, prioritizing her music over everything.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char11d]English official site[/url]]
